label: nothing
what: I cannot establish an undisclosed joint preparation from my experience. Bread transfers, freight's payment and wheat delivery, and requests for grain show supply arrangements involving baker, innkeeper and freight, but could be ordinary business. Builder installed eight hall lanterns and arranged my eighteen-hundred inspection through secretary; I was explicitly told about and approved that. Innkeeper and freight being in the hall shortly before six raises a possibility of a gathering beyond the inspection, but I have no direct evidence of its purpose or that anyone is knowingly concealing or helping prepare one. A celebration or other secret event, and its participants or helpers, remain unsupported; bridge or port changes are only unverified rumours.
